BrochureContent.Content:
We are delightd to bring to the market this idyllic property located on Inish Turbot Island. Renovated to a very high standard, this beautiful cottage enjoys miles of unspoilt sea views from its large glass windows. The living area faces south whilst the kitchen faces east with views towards Clifden Bay and countryside.  The cottage is located very close to the harbour and the magnificent white sandy beach. Beautiful natural limestone floors soak up the heat from the warming south facing sun that comes in through the large bay windows.

The high lofty ceilings give a great sense of space and the hand-crafted kitchen and bespoke wooden worktops straight from a fallen tree all add to the mix of modern and traditional charm. Whilst this cottage has all the modern conveniences it is beautifully simple.
